_description: Contract schema for Rise FC schema operator evidence map records. Defines the required shape of a future evidence map run artifact. This schema definition exists — no actual evidence map run artifact has been created. evidenceMapSchemaAdded is true; evidenceMapAdded remains false.

runId.description: Run identifier this evidence map belongs to.

targetUrl.description: Full URL of the target page this evidence map covers.

targetRoute.description: Route path of the target page.

schemaProfile.description: Active schema profile at the time this evidence map was created.

truthFingerprint.description: SHA-256 fingerprint of the truth-pack reference used when deriving evidence.

evidenceMapDate.description: ISO 8601 date the evidence map was created or last updated.

fields.description: Array of field-level evidence records — one entry per schema field considered for this run.

fieldValue.description: The confirmed value for this field. Null if held or missing.

evidenceSource.description: Source reference for this field value.

evidenceReference.description: Specific reference to the Phase 0 section, page element, or approval record confirming this field.

emissionDecision.description: Whether this field is emitted, held, deferred, or excluded from the schema draft.

heldReason.description: Reason this field is held, if emissionDecision is HELD.

conflictNotes.description: Notes if there is a conflict between Phase 0 and page evidence for this field.

heldFieldSummary.description: Summary of held field status for all 15 held field categories.

conflictResolutionPolicy.description: How conflicts between Phase 0 and page evidence are resolved.
conflictResolutionPolicy.value: Phase 0 takes precedence. Page evidence may confirm a field but may not override Phase 0. If page evidence contradicts Phase 0, the field is held pending owner review.
